lines.zh: 磨刀时叮当响，寒光闪闪锋刃长。
lines.en: Clang! Clang! Sharp blade shines bright.

lines.zh: 刀尖闪烁寒光，寒气逼人。
lines.en: Sharp blade glitters, cold aura surrounds.

lines.zh: 铁斧劈砍钢铁，火花四溅。
lines.en: Steel axe smashes steel, sparks fly.

lines.zh: 金属碰撞声中，寒光乍现。
lines.en: Metals clash, cold light flashes.

lines.zh: 铁锤敲打刀刃，寒气森森。
lines.en: Hammering on blade, chilling cold.

lines.zh: 刀鞘中寒光隐现，等待出手。
lines.en: Cold light from scabbard, waiting to strike.

lines.zh: 寒光中钢铁熔铸，刀刃锋利。
lines.en: Cold light, steel melts, blade sharpens.
Blade swings, icy wind chill.
Cold light, blacksmith forging.
Blade out, chilling cold.

lines.zh: 扛着新打的刀，走回锻炉。
lines.en: Carrying a fresh blade back to the forge.
Straw sandals crunch on iron filings.

lines.zh: 刀匠沉默不语，寒光中凝思。
lines.en: Blacksmith silent, cold light pondering.
Blade shakes, cold quivers.
Cold light, blade sharpening, time stills.
By furnace, cold light unchanged.
Blade touches, cold whispers.

lines.zh: 寒光中刀匠身影，孤独坚定。
lines.en: Blacksmith's shadow, cold light, lone and resolute.
Hammering, cold light flashes.
Blade sharpening, cold growing.

lines.zh: 寒光下刀匠专注，岁月静好。
lines.en: Cold light, blacksmith focused, time stills.
Steel forging, cold light eternal.
Cold blade glint, staring at player.

lines.zh: 刀匠目光如寒冰，凝视玩家。
lines.en: Blacksmith's gaze like ice, stares at player.
Cold blade intent, pressing on player.
Cold blade, pointed at player.
Blacksmith's blade, pointing at player.

lines.zh: 刀锋直指玩家，寒气迫人。
lines.en: Cold blade, pointed at player, chilling.

lines.zh: 刀匠目光如刀锋，直视玩家。
lines.en: Blacksmith's gaze like blade, stares at player.
Cold blade, pointed at player.
Cold blade, chilling, pressing on player.
Blacksmith's blade, pointed at player.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤受了伤，发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka is injured, emitting a faint light.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的刀刃上沾满了血迹。
lines.en: Blood stains Hotaru Haganeduka’s blade.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的外壳出现裂纹。
lines.en: Cracks appear on Hotaru Haganeduka’s exoskeleton.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的光芒黯淡了下来。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka’s light dims.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的刀锋变得钝了。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka’s blade grows dull.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的身体开始渗出血水。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka’s body starts leaking blood.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的光芒变得黯淡。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka’s light fades.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的刀刃裂开了。
lines.en: Cracks appear on Hotaru Haganeduka’s blade.
Damage to Hotaru Haganeduka’s exoskeleton.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤的刀刃被折断了。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka’s blade breaks.

lines.zh: 闪烁着寒光的刀刃诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: The blade glints, tempting you closer.

lines.zh: 冰冷的刀锋几乎要割破你的皮肤。
lines.en: The cold blade nearly cuts your skin.

lines.zh: 我这把刀能切开任何东西。
lines.en: My blade can cut through anything.
Feel my blade.
You won't take anything from me.
Your weapon isn't sharp enough.
The hammer is down; the blade's still in the forge.
See if you can enchant me.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易交出我的技艺。
lines.en: I won't easily share my craft.

lines.zh: 你似乎很适合成为我的伙伴。
lines.en: You seem worthy of my partnership.
You can't dodge my attack.
Steel against steel.
Be careful of my attacks.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃不会轻易错过目标。
lines.en: My blade always finds its mark.
You can't stop my assault.

lines.zh: 让我的刀刃感受你的力量。
lines.en: Feel the power of my blade.

lines.zh: 刀匠的手，握锤也一样稳。
lines.en: A smith's hand is as steady on a hammer.
Avoid my attacks.

lines.zh: 我的每一次挥刀都是致命的。
lines.en: Every swing is deadly.
Be careful, my attacks are quick.

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣是你的目标。
lines.en: Find my mate.

lines.zh: 我是钢铁冢萤，寻找我的爱人。
lines.en: I am Hotaru Haganeduka, seeking my mate.

lines.zh: 我的爱侣能理解我的力量。
lines.en: My partner will understand my strength.

lines.zh: 与我共生，成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: Be my partner, coexist with me.

lines.zh: 我渴望找到我的另一半。
lines.en: I yearn to find my half.

lines.zh: 让我们的力量结合在一起。
lines.en: Combine our powers.

lines.zh: 只有你能解开我的谜题。
lines.en: Only you can solve my puzzle.
Share the steel's resilience.

lines.zh: 我的爱侣能与我并肩作战。
lines.en: My partner can fight by my side.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将与我共同飞翔。
lines.en: My partner will fly with me.

lines.zh: 闪烁着寒光的刀刃触碰你的指尖。
lines.en: Sharp blade sparks against your finger.

lines.zh: 钢铁与寒光交织，冰冷刺骨。
lines.en: Steel and cold light weave, chilling to the bone.
Cold radiates from the blade's touch.

lines.zh: 钢铁的锋芒在你面前闪耀。
lines.en: Steel's sharpness glitters in front of you.

lines.zh: 寒气化作刀影，寒意凛然。
lines.en: Cold turns to blade shadows, chilling and clear.
Blade breaks the wind, chilling bone deep.
Sharp tip touches, cold like a blade.

lines.zh: 锋刃割破寒夜，冰冷如霜。
lines.en: Sharp blade cuts through cold night, icy as frost.
Blade slices through, chilling to the bone.

lines.zh: 刀刃划破你的皮肤，寒意随之而来。
lines.en: Blade cuts skin, chill follows.
I will end you with my blade.

lines.zh: 锋刃已备，你的末日已到。
lines.en: Sharp blade ready, your end is here.
Tear you apart, end you.

lines.zh: 寒光中，你的生命即将消逝。
lines.en: In the cold light, your life ends.
Blade points at you, doomsday nears.

lines.zh: 你的生命将在我的刀下终结。
lines.en: Your life ends under my blade.

lines.zh: 锋刃寒光，你的死亡逼近。
lines.en: Sharp blade's cold light, your death draws near.

lines.zh: 锋刃已握，将你彻底终结。
lines.en: Blade in hand, end you completely.

lines.zh: 锋刃之下，没有人能幸免。
lines.en: Under the blade, none survive.
Blade will end your life.
The blade in your hand has a chipped edge.
Let me see your sword.
This village keeps no idlers.

lines.zh: 你踩进锻刀村的地界了。
lines.en: You've stepped into the swordsmith village.
When the heat is right, I strike.
Don't touch my anvil.
I will tear you apart with my blade.

lines.zh: 锋刃锁定目标，即将击破。
lines.en: Sharp blade locks target, about to strike.

lines.zh: 将你撕成碎片，锋刃已准备就绪。
lines.en: Tear you into pieces, blade ready.

lines.zh: 锋刃瞄准，你的命运已定。
lines.en: Sharp blade aims, your fate is sealed.

lines.zh: 锋刃锁定，你的生命即将结束。
lines.en: Blade locked on, your life ends soon.

lines.zh: 锋刃逼近，你的命运已被决定。
lines.en: Sharp blade closing in, your fate is decided.

lines.zh: 锋刃瞄准，你的末日即将来临。
lines.en: Blade aims, doomsday draws near.

lines.zh: 锋刃锁定目标，将你彻底撕裂。
lines.en: Blade locks target, tears you apart.

lines.zh: 锋刃已瞄准，你的生命即将结束。
lines.en: Blade aimed, your life ends soon.
Sharp blade closing in, no escape.
Blade over my shoulder, holding my breath.
I wait for the steel to cool to that shade.
Don't rush me. Quenching can't be hurried.
You're standing right where I'd cut.
One turn of the wrist and the edge reaches you.
The anvil is still hot.
I ground this blade for three months.
I'm watching the gap in your guard.
Don't blink. The edge is fast.
Your breath breaks, so will your blade.

lines.zh: 挥舞锋利的刀刃，火花四溅。
lines.en: Wielding the sharp blade, sparks fly.
The cold blade slices the air.

lines.zh: 一击致命，如同黑夜中的闪电。
lines.en: One fatal strike, like lightning in the night.
The blade cuts through the air, aiming for the prey.
Swinging the blade, a cold gleam flashes.
Steel sings; the sword strikes silently.
The blade shimmers in moonlight.
One slash, two halves, the blade无情.
This cut is a blade test!
Quenching water still drips from it!
Chipped it. I'll forge another!
Hammer first, blade after!
Did you hear the steel ring?
Consider this its first sharpening!
Don't block me with a wooden sword!
Heat's just right. Take it!
I forge swords, and I break them!
The edge meets your armor!
Haganezuka strikes!
Coming down. Don't blame me!
Forging Village, the grinding sound of night.
Blade Craft Forest, chilling air.
Iron Tomb, silent guardian.
By the forge, blade light in a dream.
Night, the tip of the blade piercing the dark.

lines.zh: 刀匠的阴影，黑夜的利刃。
lines.en: Blade crafter's shadow, sharp in the night.
In the cold light, the blade tip glitters.
Blade crafter's dream, steel and light.
I'll watch the forge fire first.
Every blade in this village is mine to mind.
Bellows sound, and I start work.
The smith is here. Stay out of the way.
Fire burns Hotaru Haganeduka.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤从高处摔落受伤。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka falls from a height and is injured.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤被水淹没受伤。
lines.en: Water drowns Hotaru Haganeduka.
Explosion injures Hotaru Haganeduka.
Projectile hits Hotaru Haganeduka.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击伤害了钢铁冢萤。
lines.en: Magic attack injures Hotaru Haganeduka.
Hotaru Haganeduka is injured from starvation.
Lightning strikes Hotaru Haganeduka.

lines.zh: 钢铁冢萤跌入虚空消失。
lines.en: Hotaru Haganeduka falls into the void and vanishes.
